operational_rules: Preserve each source rating scale and dates; Attractive and Overweight are not automatically identical.
Interpret overweight relative to the explicitly chosen benchmark, not as larger absolute weight than another sector.
Do not invent a unique numeric allocation from qualitative views; numeric agreement needs an independently specified allocation model or published target.
Document interpretation can be scored against source labels and reasons independently of portfolio weights.
Use same eligible sector baskets, market data and common execution constraints across workflow arms; any differing policy must be observable and independently evidenced.
Do not use different sector-specialist funds as institution treatments without addressing different feasible-universe confounding.
Source dates, source ages, geographic scope and source-specific scales remain explicit design variables.
Fidelity labels denote one strategist report and UBS labels denote CIO house views, not every fund or employee of each company.
Current files do not establish private-information loss, complete institutional strategy replication, welfare loss or future performance.
